blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createOrderShippingMethodAdjustments` method. This belongs to the Order Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method creates shipping method adjustments.

blocks.html: This method creates a shipping method adjustment.

```ts
const shippingMethodAdjustment = await orderModuleService
  .createOrderShippingMethodAdjustments({
    shipping_method_id: "123",
    code: "50OFF",
    amount: 5
  })
```

blocks.html: This method creates shipping method adjustments for an order.

```ts
const shippingMethodAdjustments = await orderModuleService
  .createOrderShippingMethodAdjustments(
    "123",
    [{
      shipping_method_id: "123",
      code: "50OFF",
      amount: 5
    }]
  )
```
